title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Deep citations in Copilot
description: Deep citations let users quickly verify Copilot's results by linking directly to the relevant part of the reference, boosting trust. We're starting with Word and PPT files, then adding Meetings, Web, and PDF references.
